trials.agentNarrative:
Steps discovered using the public AIWF CLI help:

1. Define a small Product charter using: 
   • 'aiwf product define [options]'
   • Optionally, edit it with 'aiwf product edit [options]'

2. Create a Goal with: 
   • 'aiwf product goal new [options]'
   • Inspect existing Goals with 'aiwf product goal list' or 'aiwf product goal show <id>'

3. Relate an indexed Module to the Goal:
   • Identify the module via 'aiwf arch module list' and examine it with 'aiwf arch module show <id>'
   • Revise the Module purpose if needed with 'aiwf arch module edit <id>'
   • Use the 'link' command to relate the module and the Goal, e.g.,
         aiwf link <module-id> to <goal-id> as targets [--note "Relation details"] [--yes]

4. Report a Bug with: 
   • 'aiwf bug new [options]' or 'aiwf bug report [options]'

5. Inspect its verification using:
   • 'aiwf bug triage <id>' or 'aiwf bug history <id>'

Note: All operations produce inert previews until confirmed with --yes, and developer review is required for persistence. The steps above summarize the operations found in the CLI help outputs and align with the overall usability trial goal.
